page.content:
Anonymous imageboard that incubated many 2000s meme formats.

How 4chan connects

  • Work: Rickroll — The rickroll spread from 4chan before it hit the wider web.
  • Work: Pepe the Frog — Pepe's early meme life circulated on 4chan boards.
  • Topic: Advice Animal — 4chan boards minted many Advice Animal templates.

What is 4chan?

4chan's boards, especially /b/, were a factory for rage comics, rickrolls, Advice Animals, and Pepe's early spread. Documenting that role is history of a venue, not a brief for it.

Key threads lead to Rickroll, Pepe the Frog and Advice Animal.
